description: Helsingin pyöräväylät 2025 is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Helsingin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Helsinki's cycle path plans for 2025. The data consists of three plans: Baanaverkko 2025, Keskusta's bicycle network 2025 and the target network for bicycle traffic in suburban areas. Baananet 2025 The 2025 network plan for bicycle traffic banners contributes to meeting the targets set by the City Council for increasing bicycle traffic. Coverage: Helsingin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. The portal shows the English title as "Helsinki bicycle lanes 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Helsingin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Its keywords include pyöräily, traffic, pyöräväylät, cycling, bicycle lanes, liikenne. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
